title: tomostima sonorae
intro: Tomostima sonorae, commonly known as Desert Marigold, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the daisy family (Asteraceae). It is native to the deserts of Mexico and the southwestern United States. The health benefits of Tomostima sonorae include its potential to treat various conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues due to its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects.
